text: Cartilage is firm but flexible. Its cells, chondrocytes, sit alone or in twos in little spaces called lacunae, in a matrix of the protein chondrin. It is wrapped in a perichondrium, and it has no blood vessels at all: it is fed only by slow diffusion.
